content.title: E-commerce company, Stord, plans $40M Hebron expansion, with 500 jobs
content.summary: An Atlanta-based supply chain and logistics company plans to invest $40 million to grow its presence in Hebron, creating over 500 jobs.

thumbnail.caption: Atlanta-based Stord operates a warehouse facility in Hebron, Kentucky, and now plans to add a second fulfillment facility nearby as part of a $40 million investment in the Bluegrass State.
